events.title: Closed Playtests Begin Soon
events.summary: The gods are getting hungry.In the next couple of weeks, we’ll start inviting the first players into closed Grilluminati playtests.Want to join the first playtests?Join our Discord and assign yourself the Sacrifices role. events.title: 25,000 Future Cultists
events.summary: The congregation continues to grow.Since announcing Grilluminati less than a month ago, more than 25,000 people have added the game to their wishlist. It's been incredible to see the response so far, and we're hard at work turning Grilluminati into the chaotic co-op cult experience we envisioned.If you'd like to follow development more closely, join the congregation on Discord:👉 Join Our DiscordThank you for helping us reach this milestone.The gods are watching.— The Steakholders

events.title: 10,000 Souls Acquired
events.summary: The rituals are working.We've just passed 10,000 wishlists for Grilluminati, and we wanted to say thank you to everyone who has followed, shared, commented, and spread the word about our totally legitimate steakhouse.Seeing so many people excited about our chaotic co-op cult game has been incredible, and we're grateful for every single wishlist.We're hard at work preparing more reveals, more gameplay, and more opportunities for you to join the cult.
